counterfactual_missing_items: FDG uptake in the adrenal glands
decisive_items: An 18 FDG PET/CT showed intense uptake (SUVmax 25.5) in the right testis
Testicular ultrasound showed enlargement and inhomogeneity of the right testis and epididymis
no uptake in the adrenal glands
response.rationale: R4 best explains the testicular mass with intense FDG uptake, consistent with lymphoma in an elderly male. The adrenal enlargement is not FDG-avid, ruling out adrenal lymphoma or metastasis, and the absence of endocrine symptoms argues against adrenal hyperplasia. R7 (Leydig cell tumor) is less likely given the high SUV and lack of hormonal features.

rejected.why: Primary adrenal lymphoma is contradicted by the lack of FDG uptake in the adrenal glands, which would be expected in lymphoma.
Metastatic cancer to the adrenals would typically show FDG uptake; the absence of uptake makes this unlikely, and the testicular mass is better explained as a primary lymphoma.
Primary adrenal macronodular hyperplasia does not explain the testicular mass and high FDG uptake, and the absence of cortisol excess symptoms argues against it.
